releaseNotes:
Feature: SIM modem data monitor (driver-based, Huawei HiLink first) — dashboard card with usage gauge, remaining GB, daily bars, live speed and days-left forecast
Feature: Modem alerts at 70/80/90/100% to Telegram and desktop toast, operator usage SMS detection, and one-click Reset after buying a new package
Feature: Modem SMS manager — inbox/sent with cards, pagination, search, select-all, delete, send SMS; package SMS can be added to the plan size
Feature: Temporary (session-only) path mapping from the remote tree with an End button — nothing is saved
Feature: Path mappings can target folders outside the connection root, so many sites on one server work with a single connection
Feature: Settings sections use horizontal tabs, Modem has its own section, Direct Upload options redesigned with Persian tooltips; select-all moved to the root '/' row
Fix: Direct Upload with Overwrite off now creates new files and folders on FTP instead of failing
